claims: Sq19.square19_optimality (L : ℝ) : Sq19.Feasible19 L ↔ 3 + 4 * √2 / 3 ≤ L, where Feasible19 L says that there are 19 sets, each a closed unit square Sq19.sq cx cy ux uy with ux^2 + uy^2 = 1 (Sq19.IsUnitSquare), each inside [0, L]^2, with pairwise disjoint interiors; existence at the endpoint is included (Sq19Lean/Assembly/Optimality.lean, Assembly/PlainPacking.lean, SquareBase.lean, Basic.lean, EndpointPacking.lean, expected/statement.txt, README.md)

Trust boundary: propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound and 4,320 native_decide certificate checks, no sorryAx, so Lean's compiler and native evaluator are trusted (verification/Square19Optimality.log, expected/axioms.txt, README.md)

Kernel replay: LeanChecker.replayFromImports over every module of the theorem's 13,143-module import closure, Mathlib included, 0 failures, on the compiled objects of the research build of 15 October 2026, repeated by scripts/verify.py --kernel-replay on 16 October (verification/kernel-replay.json, README.md)

The generated certificate modules are in release v1.0.0's five archives; scripts/fetch.sh checks each archive against SHA256SUMS and each of the 2,112 extracted files against expected/generated-sources.sha256, and a full build takes several hours on a 64-core, 512 GB machine (scripts/fetch.sh, scripts/verify.py, README.md)
